item.title: Opinion: When governments threaten the courts, democracy is at risk
item.description: Recent comments by Alberta Premier Danielle Smith — particularly suggestions that judicial funding could be curtailed if her government doesn’t get more say in appointing judges — should concern every single Albertan, regardless of political affiliation.
